text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer.
Thank you for giving me some time off.
choice_data_list: Did you get to refresh yourself?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I watched a musical over the break!
It was a story about a dancer seizing the lead role on a grand stage, but—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Even when everyone around said it was impossible,
seeing them believe in themselves and keep striving was so inspiring...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: During that final scene, my body just started moving on its own...!
Win Variation gained energy from the success story, seemingly refreshed in both body and mind.
